invariants: Evidence qualification is scoped to the exact contract version, repository revision, test artifact and configuration world.
Changing contract semantics invalidates previous evidence applicability even when the test file path is unchanged.
Invalidation changes the present applicability state but does not erase the historical evidence event.
A later passing run under the new contract can qualify only the exact new revision and declared world.
A proposed future change must not mutate the observed current snapshot or be represented as an executed result.
Unknown, skipped, missing or mismatched evidence never becomes pass by inference.

negative_controls.attack: Promote E1 to current at revision B without a new run.
Treat a skipped workflow as a passed test.
Reuse E2 when the target triple differs from its recorded world.
Mark proposed contract-v3 work as observed and mutate current snapshot.
Delete E1 from history after invalidation.
Keep E1 current because tests/contract.rs path string is unchanged.
Reuse E1 for a changed evaluator version without independent regrade.

claim_ceiling: Known-answer design fixture only; no implementation, benchmark performance, runtime, security or SOTA claim.
